text: Registered investment advisers must report systemic risk relevant information to the SEC, including trading practices, trading and investment positions, the amount of assets under management, valuation policies, and side letters.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Impact of Dodd-Frank Act Compliance Cost on the Hedge Fund Industry (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389423

isBasedOn.name: The Impact of Dodd-Frank Act Compliance Cost on the Hedge Fund Industry

abstract: Investment advisers must provide reports with respect to certain information related to systemic risk (Dodd-Frank § 404(b)(3)), such as trading practices, trading and investment positions, the amount of AUM, valuation policies, side letters

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: investment advisers registered under Title IV
